problem.title: Sound familiar?

pains.title: “My website doesn't express my business.”
pains.text: Visitors don't understand at first glance what you do or why they should choose you. And they leave without getting in touch.

pains.title: “It looks just like all the others.”
pains.text: Templates, stock photos, generic copy… But none of what makes you special shows up.

pains.title: “I feel awkward sending the link.”
pains.text: You know your work is worth more than your website shows. And it holds you back every time someone asks to see it.

problem.closing: It's not talent that's missing. It's the message...

how.title: Nothing appears by chance
how.introLine1: A website communicates, even before anyone reads a single word...
how.introLine2: That's why I craft every detail with care and intention.

pillars.title: Words
pillars.text: Words are our main tool for understanding each other. How they're used can take people to very specific places.

pillars.title: Colour
pillars.text: Every shade and combination conveys something: trust, energy, calm, and more. They're a powerful way to say exactly what you mean.

pillars.title: Shape
pillars.text: Typography, space and composition that organise your message and guide the eye.

pillars.title: Movement
pillars.text: Meaningful animations that introduce and accompany whoever experiences your message, without distracting from it.

how.closing: The result: a website that mirrors your message.

bond.text: Bond is CAMY's business management platform. Built for coaches, therapists, nutritionists and other professionals who work in sessions or programmes. Run your business and care for your clients from one place, with your brand.

items.q: How long does my website take?
items.a: One takes 1 to 2 weeks. Multi, 3 to 4. Custom depends on the project. The timeline starts on the agreed start date, once I have all the material.

items.q: And how long does Bond take?
items.a: Once you send me your logo, colours and schedule, your platform is ready in 7 days. If you already have clients in another tool, I migrate them for you, and in that case it may take a few more days.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: Your texts or the information to write them, photos, logo and access to your domain. I'll send you a clear list when we start.

items.q: What does “unlimited changes to the approved design” mean?
items.a: First we agree on the design. From then on, I adjust everything you need until it's just the way you want it. A complete change of concept is quoted separately.

items.q: What language do we work in?
items.a: In English or Spanish, whichever you prefer.

items.q: When is my website fully mine?
items.a: When you complete the payment. If you pay in two parts, the design and code become yours with the second payment.

pain.title: Your job is to guide people. But everything else eats up your time.
items: You jump between your calendar, WhatsApp, paper notes and your bank.
You work out appointment times one message at a time.
A client ends up with no next session, and nothing tells you.
You chase bank transfers and can't tell who owes you what.
Before every session, you hunt for what you talked about last time.
pain.closing: Your service is excellent. Your organisation should live up to it.

It organises your bookings, your clients, your notes and your payments, and gives each client their own space, with your brand and the care they deserve. vivamexico.name: Viva México
vivamexico.client: Javier Reyes · Professional mariachi band since 1992 · NRW
vivamexico.challenge: Their website was an outdated WordPress site that didn't convey the energy of their music. They needed to renew it without losing what they had gained on Google, and to speak to both their German audience and the Latin community.

With a careful migration to keep their rankings, and cookie consent in line with German regulations.

hero.title: Behind CAMY there's a rough and beautiful story
hero.subtitle: Let me tell you…

story.text: For years I chose freedom: travelling, creating, moving around the world without anchors. I lived on 3 continents, emigrated 5 times, survived 2 kidnappings and 2 bankruptcies. I've learnt more than any university could ever have taught me.
For the first time, I wanted to be a father... And Camila arrived.
She arrived in the best conditions for her and the worst for me…

Germany: an extraordinary country to have and raise children, but a hard one for a Latino with no language, no network, an accent that gives him away and a culture that doesn't always open its doors and contrasts in profound ways.

That's where I learnt and lived what it means to have something valuable to share and express, and have very few people receive it... Being judged on "where you come from" or "how you sound", and not on what's really there... That's why I know how important it is for a message to arrive as close as possible to its origin and to how it feels...
In the middle of all this turmoil, against a backdrop of disbelief from those closest to me, CAMY was born.
A desperate, daring and slightly unbalanced decision; like almost everything I've done in life that has been worth it…
CAMY is named after my daughter. And every client I help to show themselves as they truly are is one more step towards everything I want to give her.
I don't work for a salary. I work for her.
